The Captain has sworn a vow to loyally serve his lord. This trait grants a free relationship with the Lord Protector provided the player writes a Belief about him. If the player decides not to write a Belief or the Belief changes, the trait becomes a character trait. If he later writes a Belief about the Lord Protector, the trait is reactivated.

Type: Dt (die trait). Unpriced: costs 1 pt as a lifepath trait.

Restrictions: Elven lifepath trait

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 349
